items.title: Traditional Islamic Star Polygons Fretwork Template for CNC Milling
items.description: Introduce authentic heritage into your architectural installations with this traditional Islamic fretwork pattern, featuring a continuous grid of interlocking star polygons and sharp geometric shapes. Engineered flawlessly in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this vector design ensures maximum material stability during production. Ideal for workshop owners producing custom Mashrabiya window panels, suspended ceilings, and historic architectural cladding.

items.title: Angular Crisscross DXF Pattern for Industrial Door Screens
items.description: Sharp diagonal lines cross and overlap at random angles, forming a raw, energetic web across the panel. The irregular geometry brings an industrial, deconstructed edge to loft doors, workshop gates, and modern facades.

items.title: Luxury Arabesque Panel Vector Design for CNC and Laser Cutting
items.description: Download this premium, production-ready arabesque pattern optimized for high-end manufacturing. Available in fully scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this classic design features elegant symmetrical swirls and damask-inspired floral motifs. Engineered specifically for clean execution on CNC routers, laser cutters, and plasma machines. Ideal for fabricators creating luxury room dividers, privacy screens, and decorative interior wall panels.
